items: 【L Desk with Power Outlets】Our home office desk comes with 4 AC outlets, 1 USB ports, and 1 Type-C port, so you can easily charge your devices, plug in your laptop, or connect your lamp without the hassle of finding an available socket. Keep your workspace clean and organized

【3 Drawers Home Desk】Say goodbye to clutter with 3 spacious fabric drawers. Whether you're storing office supplies, gaming accessories, or personal items, these drawers provide the perfect solution to keep your essentials neatly organized and within easy reach

【Reversible Workspace】The L-shaped design of this corner computer desk is perfect for optimizing your workspace. With reversible shelves that can be installed on either side, you can install the writing desk to fit your unique setup, whether you’re working solo or collaborating with a partner

【Durable Structure, Mutiple Uses】Crafted with sturdy particle board, a robust metal frame, and adjustable feet, this work desk for home office is designed to withstand daily use and provide a stable work surface. The X-shaped back supports enhance the desk’s durability in your home office or gaming room

【Easy Assembly】From home offices to gaming rooms, this l shape gaming desk with sleek L-shape design allowing for efficient use of space easily fits into any environment. With clear and easy-to-follow instruction, provided tools and numbered components, this desk will be set up in a while
